servicesPage.heading: Advisory Services Built Around Your Life Goals
servicesPage.subtitle: Explore each pillar in detail or jump directly to the area where you need clarity today.

pillars.title: Mutual Funds & SIP
pillars.tagline: Disciplined wealth creation tailored to short-, medium-, and long-term goals.
pillars.whoFor: Salaried professionals, business owners, and families building long-term wealth systematically without tracking stock tickers daily.
included: Risk-profile assessment before selecting equity, hybrid, or debt categories
Step-Up SIP mapping so monthly investments grow alongside annual income
Lump-sum deployment strategy (STP where appropriate) for bonuses or property proceeds
Consolidated portfolio tracking to prevent duplicate scheme overlap
pillars.cadence: Semi-annual or annual allocation review, plus volatility hand-holding during sharp market swings.

pillars.title: Financial Planning
pillars.tagline: Connecting every rupee you earn to measurable family milestones.
pillars.whoFor: Young couples, mid-career families, and pre-retirees who want one coherent plan instead of ad-hoc investments.
included: Household cash-flow & surplus review with a dedicated emergency reserve plan
Children's higher education & marriage corpus sizing adjusted for education inflation
Retirement corpus & post-retirement monthly income sustainability planning
Debt prioritization checklist (home loans vs. high-cost consumer debt)
pillars.cadence: Annual goal progress audit and updates on major life events (marriage, childbirth, job switch).

pillars.title: Insurance
pillars.tagline: Pure risk protection so unexpected medical or life events never derail your goals.
pillars.whoFor: Earning members with financial dependents, aging parents, or outstanding loans.
included: Pure Term Life Insurance sizing based on income replacement and liabilities
Family floater Health Insurance & Super Top-Up adequacy check
Critical illness / personal accident coverage gap analysis
Unbiased evaluation of existing endowment/money-back/ULIP policies
pillars.cadence: Reviewed at renewal cycles and whenever family size or loan liabilities change.

pillars.title: Tax Saving & Portfolio Review
pillars.tagline: Streamline legacy investments and align tax savings with long-term growth.
pillars.whoFor: Taxpayers scrambling in March or investors holding 15+ scattered schemes without knowing true net returns.
included: Section 80C (ELSS) & Section 80D planning aligned to your chosen tax regime
Portfolio health diagnostic highlighting overlapping, underperforming, or high-cost holdings
Consolidation of legacy investments into a simpler, trackable structure
pillars.cadence: Mid-year tax check (Oct–Dec) and structured portfolio cleanup every 12 months.

aboutPage.heading: Sachin Jagtap — Founder, Right Investment
aboutPage.intro: Right Investment was built with a straightforward belief: Indian families deserve clear, honest, unhurried financial guidance in the language they think in—whether English or Marathi.
bioParagraphs: Too many households end up holding mismatched insurance policies, redundant mutual funds, and last-minute tax-saving products bought from unrelated contacts. Without a unified strategy, hard-earned savings work below their potential.

At Right Investment, Sachin Jagtap works closely with salaried professionals, families, and small business owners to replace guesswork with structure: securing family risk first, mapping every SIP to a real milestone, and staying accountable through market cycles.
This profile section is ready for Sachin Jagtap's full personal biography and years of practice details.

privacyPage.heading: Privacy Notice
privacyPage.subtitle: How Right Investment handles the personal details you share while requesting a consultation.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: When you submit the consultation request form, we collect your name, phone number, optional email address, chosen advisory topic, preferred language, callback window, and any optional goal notes you voluntarily provide.

sections.title: 2. How Your Details Are Used
sections.body: Your details are used solely to contact you regarding your requested financial consultation and prepare relevant discussion points. Right Investment does not sell, rent, or distribute your contact data to telemarketers or third-party lead aggregators.

sections.title: 3. Data Deletion & Contact
sections.body: You may request correction or deletion of your inquiry details at any time by calling or messaging +91 95610 01821 or emailing our listed contact address.
